Tacto builds Industrial AI for procurement in manufacturing. Built for industrial complexity, designed to optimize every procurement decision.

OUR MISSION AT TACTO

We make industry stronger.

Manufacturing is the backbone of the European economy, and supply chains are its biggest challenge. Yet procurement in many companies still runs on Excel and legacy systems. With AI, we are fundamentally changing how manufacturers buy: measurably lower material costs and far less manual work.

YOUR ROLE

You build the teams that build Tacto, working directly with our CEO and Chief of Staff.

Why this role exists

We are entering our next growth phase in the AGI age: new markets, new teams and the structures that carry them. Almost all of it runs through people: who we hire, how we set up teams and the culture of ambition we protect. As a Venture Developer, you own several hiring pipelines across functions, from Sales to Tech to Customer Value, and you help make Tacto the place where the best talent in Europe wants to work. Our own AI agents do much of the searching and first outreach, so about half of your week goes to what only people get to do: speaking to talent, judging fit and giving every candidate a great experience. You work directly with André (CEO) and Marla (Chief of Staff).

Why your role matters

- You decide who gets in. You run the first interviews and shape which candidates our hiring managers meet. Every person you move forward can shape a team at Tacto for years. Talent is our biggest lever in building a generational company.

Ecole sous tutelle du ministère de l’économie, des finances et de la souveraineté industrielle et numérique, et école de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, IMT Nord Europe a 3 missions principales : former des ingénieurs responsables aptes à résoudre les grandes problématiques du XXIème siècle ; mener des recherches débouchant sur des innovations à haute valeur ajoutée ; soutenir le développement des territoires notamment en facilitant l’innovation et les créations d’entreprises. Son objectif est de former les ingénieurs de demain, maîtrisant à la fois les technologies numériques et les savoir-faire industriels.
